correctness.rationale: The exact domain and rank assumptions are stated. The proof cites the published Volkov defect-one primitivity theorem, establishes all invariant quotient partitions for the cyclic letter, proves rank forces quotient permutations, and explicitly counts all intersections via rooted-chain quotient permutations and one defective fiber. Inclusion-exclusion, total-map enumeration and the freeness of cyclic relabeling complete the proof. The finite four/eight-state direct pair-automaton census agrees with an independently coded arithmetic formula and has zero structural-classification discrepancies. The unbounded quantifier follows from the proof, not the finite tests.

value.rationale: Failure of synchronization is a natural probability under a minimal nonpermutation perturbation of a circular group automaton. The theorem exactly counts the full exceptional family for each prime-power size, gives exact failure probabilities and cyclic-quotient cardinalities, and handles genuinely overlapping residue-congruence causes by explicit factorial intersection factors. This is a complete motivated infinite enumerative classification, not a routine isolated value or unmotivated numeric slice.
